description:
ABOUT NOOKS.AI http://Nooks.ai:

Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.

Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running. 



About the Role:
We are looking for a Software Engineer, Security to build the capabilities that protect customer data and help enterprise customers use our products with confidence. Your primary focus will be shipping product security and compliance features, from access controls and auditability to safe handling of sensitive data.

You'll also shape the shared security architecture, libraries, and tooling that make secure defaults part of how Nooks engineers build. Working with Security, Engineering, Product, Design, and Compliance, you'll own problems from technical design through production rollout and help secure an expanding set of AI-enabled products.



What you’ll do:

 - Build product security capabilities and compliance features. Design and ship authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, audit logging, and customer data controls with partner teams.

 - Create secure defaults. Build shared libraries, frameworks, service patterns, and baselines that make secure implementations straightforward to adopt.

 - Find and fix risks in production software. Threat-model features, review designs and code, remediate vulnerabilities, and harden web, backend/API, and mobile components with tests that prevent recurrence.

 - Turn requirements into working controls. Partner with Compliance and product teams to translate applicable customer and framework requirements, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001, into practical engineering controls and verifiable evidence.

 - Improve security through automation. Build tooling and CI/CD guardrails, reduce repetitive security work, and use AI to assist code review, triage, and threat modeling while validating its output.

 - Lead cross-functional security initiatives. Work with Engineering, Product, and Design from prioritization through rollout, including production controls for AI features, agents, and integrations that address data exposure, excessive permissions, prompt injection, and unsafe tool use.



We’re looking for someone who has:

 - 6+ years of relevant experience in security-focused software engineering, product security, application security, or software engineering with substantial security ownership.

 - A track record of delivering high-quality production software, with strong coding, testing, debugging, and operational skills.

 - Strong application-security fundamentals in authentication, authorization, API security, and sensitive-data handling, with experience identifying and remediating software vulnerabilities.

 - Ability to design maintainable solutions, own ambiguous projects, and drive prioritization and tradeoff discussions with cross-functional teams.

 - Clear communication, collaborative judgment, curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving problems and learning.

Nice to haves:

 - Experience building security practices, shared libraries, or developer guardrails at a high-growth startup.

 - Experience with AI/ML or LLM-based applications and their security controls, or enterprise security and compliance capabilities.



Compensation at Nooks for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, hybrid work, and unlimited paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

We offer competitive compensation because we want to hire the best people and reward them for their contributions to our mission. Please reference the job posting’s subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the location listed is: $200K - $315K annually.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
